metadata.description: The @dereekb/zoho/node entry (rollup, inferred from rollup.config.cjs): compiles into dist/packages/zoho/node and is named by the parent's `./node` export. The node-only, NestJS-free helpers of the Zoho family (the file-system access token cache): it imports node:fs through @dereekb/nestjs's nest-free file helpers but never @nestjs/*, so zoho-cli can bundle it without the NestJS runtime and @dereekb/zoho/nestjs re-exports it unchanged. An explicit edge to zoho:build-base, NOT `^build`: `^build` would resolve to zoho:build, which depends on this very target -- a hard cycle. util and nestjs are other families, so their ROOT `build` is the edge (the finalized copy TypeScript resolves `exports` against). package.json also lists @dereekb/rxjs with no source usage: @dereekb/zoho's and @dereekb/nestjs's .d.ts files import it, and an undeclared one resolves to its SOURCE through the tsconfig paths, which fails the rollup declaration pass with TS6059 (outside rootDir); zoho:build-base already builds it through `^build`. The parent's `build` aggregates this target, so the entry point has no `build` of its own.
